prior_inspection: Source formats, quantity, identities and timeline anomalies inspected; no model performance observed. Not source-blind.
family: union exact SALAMI bytes, NFKD casefold alphanumeric title+artist and title-only; index and header aliases both used
representative: lowest numeric slot ID; no replacement after rejection
split: family ID billboard-family:SHA256(comma-joined sorted decimal slot IDs)[:24]; sort SHA256(20261117-billboard:+family), first ceil(20 percent) test
selection: lowest sha256(20261117-billboard:family:index), then original index order
coalesce: adjacent exact raw chord only, identical tonic/meter, contiguous within1e-8; preserve bass changes
barriers: unsupported quality,N,X,unknown tonic/meter,context change,gap>1e-8 break; nonpositive duration or overlap>1e-8 rejects whole slot; inline-meter phrase entirely null until next phrase
context_mapping: SALAMI #tonic/#metre at next timestamped phrase; reject LAB event straddling context boundary; inline metre invalidates phrase only
slash: root+quality target ignores slash bass, retained separately in external provenance; extended/altered quality excluded, not simplified
evaluation_claim: Current fresh-model family heldout only; historical exposure and alternate-title covers unresolved
rights: CC0 annotations only; source audio/composition rights not granted
